description: GitHub Actions update policy. Third-party actions are pinned to digests (via config:best-practices) for supply-chain safety. Updates are grouped monthly to reduce PR churn — SHA pinning is the security mechanism, not update frequency.

packageRules.description: Do not pin internal commercetools Actions/reusable workflows to digests; trust the floating major tag.
Group all non-major GitHub Actions updates into a single monthly PR.
schedule: before 9am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Major GitHub Actions updates get their own PR for review, still monthly.
schedule: before 9am on the first day of the month
